title: fxv branch info command payload
description: One branch as a workspace sees it. Used as the `fxv branch info` payload, and as the element type of `fxv branch list`'s array.

branch.description: The branch's displayed form: a bare name for a global branch, '<username>/<name>' for a user branch.

branch_unique_id.description: The branch's unique ID as bare hex. Stable for the branch's whole life, unlike 'branch', which a rename changes, and the only thing that distinguishes two branches sharing a name. For matching payloads to each other; no command accepts it as an argument.

branch_type.description: Whether the branch is owned by a user or lives in the global namespace.

owner.description: The owning user's current username. Absent for a global branch, which is owned by nobody.

published_head.description: The branch's published head revision. Absent for a branch that has never been published.

draft_head.description: This workspace's draft head revision on the branch. Absent when it holds no local drafts on it.

local_only.description: Whether the branch exists only in this workspace, so nobody else can see it or sync to it yet.

retired.description: Whether the branch has been retired, hiding it from default listings.
